'''2011 Yavin 4 Regionals John Anderson LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2011 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Watch "Yore" Step
* '''Username:''' puck71
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
